_README: Machine canon for The Event Horizon (SEALED). Updated after every played episode from the player's save (PROCESS.md step 2). The save wins over the plan. 'knowledge' lists who knows each fact IN THIS PLAYTHROUGH; never let a character reference a fact they're not on.

sam.status: Temple freshman, Cardone Hall 9-14, Ciro's delivery

jules.powers: Changed in the Hitch (ES-44). Probability. Hidden from Sam all of Season 1.

simone.notes: Keeps a Notes-app list titled 'Things That Don't Add Up About Juliet'. From the pilot she also tracks Sam's nosebleed.

vinnie.status: Laborers' Local 57 apprentice on the Halcyon Navy Yard build-out

grace.status: 9th-floor RA, pre-med senior; had a probation semester (her father's stroke), not public

femi.status: Temple junior, econ; Charles Library circulation desk; ES-31 (Unnoticeable) once changed in the Hitch. Dies in E8 by plan.

frank.secret: Owes the Iannuccis $41,000. Ignoring calls from 215-555-4471 (Dante).

nonna.secret: 1918: her mother Assunta stepped between the seconds. She felt Sam move. Gave him a key (pilot, if he came to Sunday dinner); it opens a tin box in her cedar chest holding Assunta's diary and a stopped pocket watch reading 11:51.

mikey.status: PPD patrol, 3rd District. Army 2018–2022, one Afghanistan deployment (2020).

carmen.status: Hip broken in the Hitch (Sam failed the roll). At Temple University Hospital. Sam has NOT visited. Has NOT signed Halcyon papers yet.

jayden.secret: Latent (Halcyon lists him as a 'possible' ES-62, a post-Event case). Pays off in Season 7.

weisz.secret: ES-50. Sees seams and Changed people as 'blurry edges'.

old_sam.secret: The Revenant. Pilot: one sighting across Broad (tag).

ear_tell.text: Jules says you touch your left ear when you lie.

first_rewind.text: In the frozen moment, you failed, and time ran backward to give you another try. You failed again anyway.

halcyon_aperture.text: Inside Halcyon, a screen read APERTURE, counting down to 11:51. Below it: SUBJECT FIELD 1.9 MI · CONTAINMENT NOMINAL.

halcyon_tablet_man.text: A calm man from Halcyon in a gray polo swept Broad Street with a tablet after the light.

jayden_cold_man.text: The boy, Jayden, called you "the cold man."

jules_callum.text: Jules has a boyfriend: Callum Whitford, Penn Crew. He's nice. That's the problem.

jules_changed.text: Jules was changed in the Hitch.

jules_chose_temple.text: Jules says she's never broken a rule. That was the lie. She chose Temple, apparently over her mother's objections.

jules_die_sixes.text: Jules's ivory die rolls nothing but sixes now.

jules_glass.text: The window came down on Jules in the Hitch, and every piece of glass missed her.

jules_handkerchief.text: You have Jules's handkerchief: white, ironed, JLP in navy thread. "Keep it."

jules_ivory_die.text: Jules carries an old ivory die from her grandmother. "It isn't lucky. Luck isn't real."

jules_never_loses.text: Jules says she has never lost a game of cards. It was one of her truths.

jules_twin.text: Jules has a twin brother at Penn.

lied_nik.text: You lied to Nik about the Slip. He didn't buy it.

man_across_street.text: A man across Broad Street had your face, older, scarred, missing his left ring finger. He put a finger to his lips. Then he was gone.

nonna_jacket.text: Nonna: "Saturday, near midnight, the clocks. Wear a jacket."

owe_jules_favor.text: You owe Jules Pemberton one favor. Any favor. Her choosing, whenever she wants.

pop_unknown_calls.text: Pop keeps declining calls from the same unknown number: a 215 number ending in 4471.

sam_slip.text: Your secret: when the world stopped, you didn't.

slip_rules.text: When you Slip: the world stops, it's freezing, you're starving after, and your nose bleeds.

wawa_guy.text: A video of you at the Wawa on Broad went viral. The internet calls you WAWA GUY.

weisz_strange.text: Dr. Weisz told the class the Corliss Engine stopped "for a heartbeat" in 1876. After class he told you your edges were blurry.

open_threads.note: Unknown-number calls; Melrose Diner breakfast with Dante Iannucci (if Vinnie FaceTime). Surfaces in E7.
Tablet man = Cole Brannigan. hidden.halcyon_heat tracks how hot Sam is. Achterberg at the glass. 'APERTURE' screen.
Glass circle; the pool ball stopped (if crit); die sixes (camera only); hidden nudges counter.

open_threads.note: If the pool bet was a favor, Jules will call it in 'when it'll hurt the most'. Best used in S2 or S3.
Tag sighting. Frozen puddle if Sam crossed. Next sighting E5.
'You moved.' The key (if dinner). Full story begins E5. Sam skipped Sunday dinner: no key yet, and Nonna has not said "You moved."
'Your edges are blurry.' Office hours Tue/Thu.

open_threads.status: ACTIVE: the video exists. Sam mocked the name; Jules: "It's perfect."
open_threads.note: Press name if a video exists (flag 'video'). Dana Fiorillo picks it up in E2 → 'the Broad Street Blur'.
San Judas medal (if visited). Halcyon settlement signed or not. Jayden: 'Can you teach me?'
Lied to Nik Sunday (miss). Heat 3. Resolve in E2 cold open.
Sam failed the Hitch roll; Carmen hip. Savior guilt fuel.
Carmen says she saw Sam "go back. Two times." She perceived the rewind. Possible latent sensitivity, or the Audience leaking. Decide by S2.
Teddy Kowal (stasis), Heck Ramos (furnace), Bree Kowal (echo). Robbing for Halina Kowal's transplant at Jefferson. Bree keeps recordings of Sam's voice.
Brannigan has a provisional ES-17 file. He has noticed the lamp in 9-11 (Jules).

Liberty Loan parade; 'the night the bells stopped'; Assunta DiNardo steps between seconds.
